title: rosa canina subvar. spuria
intro: Rosa canina subvar. spuria, commonly known as the Dog Rose, is a flowering plant that belongs to the rose family and is native to Europe and Western Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina subvar. spuria include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and vitamins, particularly vitamin C, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
